text:
emily_sales: FYI Galileo wants a 25m live POC next Friday. They will run browser clients with streaming chat. Ask: ephemeral hosted key + temporary QPS increase.

ryan_ds: Numbers? concurrent users, avg tokens, region?

emily_sales: ~100 concurrent users, bursts to ~500 RPS for ~5-8 minutes, avg ~70 tokens, region: us-east-1. They need the key by Thu EOD for integration tests.

carla_sre: Hosted can support a short burst. Suggest scoped key with burst_qps=600, window 30m (10m warmup), token_limit=50_000_000, streaming enabled. Plan fallback: auto-route to redwood-small-chat if 95p latency > 800ms.

dan_se: I can create the key and attach ip_allowlist if they provide subnets. Also will add telemetry tag=galileo-demo and short-lived log retention for audit.

emily_sales: Can we cap total tokens to keep finance happy? They want a predictable bill.

quota-bot: Request submitted: TEMP_QPS_GALILEO by emily_sales. Request ID: TR-2085004444. Status: pending_finance.

carla_sre: To reduce tokens: enable KV prefix cache for repeated prompts, set max_response_tokens=120, and recommend client to dedupe keep-alive pings.

dan_se: curl example for Galileo (replace <SCOPED_KEY>):

curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <SCOPED_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-large","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"start"}]}' \
  https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/chat/stream

ryan_ds: Quick cost calc: assume 500 RPS sustained for 8m spike -> 500*70*480 = 16.8M tokens. Add baseline and buffer -> ~30M. We'll request 50M cap.

emily_sales: Perfect. Please loop in finance and confirm before Thu EOD. Galileo expects a green key after approval. :rocket:
